bio.text: Rachel Fetty Anderson, a Democrat, won her party's nomination for U.S. Senate in West Virginia in the May 12, 2026 primary, according to the Associated Press, defeating former state Senate president Jeff Kessler and others.
The AP describes her as a public interest attorney and advocate for three decades who served two terms on the Morgantown City Council.

According to West Virginia Watch's voter guide, Anderson has been a public interest attorney and advocate for almost 30 years and, as an attorney, represents clients in the foster care system, victims of domestic violence, people with disabilities, and insurance appeals for free.
